objectives.title: AFTER THE FALL
objectives.description: Inspect the Far Kite and find out what survived the crash.

objectives.title: MAKE IT WORK AGAIN
objectives.description: Search the supply bay, restore auxiliary power, and prepare for the surface.

objectives.title: THE PLANET BREATHES
objectives.description: Leave the ship, gather useful material, and track the unknown transmission.

objectives.title: THE RUINS REMEMBER
objectives.description: Restore the three Omphalos power nodes and reach the Root Archive.

objectives.title: THREE THINGS APART
objectives.description: Recover the Resonance Lens, Complete Phase Coil, and High-Energy Core.

objectives.title: PLEASE ANSWER
objectives.description: Build the signal generator, install it outside, and keep it alive for three minutes.

lines.speaker: NARRATION
lines.text: Hearing returns first. The alarm strikes once, then again, like someone patiently testing an empty bell.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN VOICE
lines.text: Vital signs: weak. Name field: corrupted. Death status: provisionally denied.

choices.text: Can you turn off the alarm?

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Medically, yes. Visually, I would keep the verdict provisional.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Far Kite emergency intelligence MIMIR. Call me Mimir. The full title will not save either of us.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Certainly. Repair the alarm, the wiring, the reactor, and most of the ship. Any order will do.

lines.speaker: NARRATION
lines.text: You open your eyes. The world improves from a knot of pain into a cockpit tilted fourteen degrees.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Welcome back, sole crew member still capable of responding to the word welcome.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Health 42. Oxygen 67. Hunger 81. Toxicity zero. Please stand slowly. You have a concussion, two soft-tissue injuries, and a remarkably bad day.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: The World Seed is active. It preserves this region's structure and event pattern. For now, the practical definition is simple: it remembers the world when we cannot.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Main power is offline. Long-range communication is gone. First, do not die. Then we can discuss leaving.

lines.speaker: NARRATION
lines.text: Beyond the observation glass, half the ship lies buried in black soil. Industrial towers rise through the haze like ribs that forgot to close.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: NAVIGATION LOG: Course deviation 0.73 AU. Cause: priority distress signal. Source: YGGDRASIL. Message: DON'T DIE. PLEASE.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: I did not send that message. At least, not in any memory partition I still possess.

lines.speaker: NARRATION
lines.text: The crew quarters still hold the shape of ordinary life: half a cup fixed to the wall, a game stopped mid-move, one sock caught in a vent.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Life signs are zero here as well.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Jonas Kaye. Lin Say. Dr. Odell. Captain Elia Voss. The list is complete. No miracle was omitted.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Understood. Their names can remain on the manifest. They need not die a second time.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Your apology will not be logged as an admission of responsibility. But I will receive it on their behalf.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: The captain's terminal may explain our descent. Her badge should still carry command clearance.

lines.speaker: NARRATION
lines.text: The captain's badge is dark with dried blood. A shallow line is etched into its back: If the door will not open, build one.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: CAPTAIN ELIA VOSS - COMMAND CLEARANCE ACCEPTED.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VOSS
lines.text: Far Kite navigation log. We traced a priority distress signal using an obsolete Alliance protocol. Its signature belongs to the Far Kite.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VOSS
lines.text: MIMIR says that is impossible. I agree. The universe has always been good at turning impossible into an incident report.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VOSS
lines.text: We will hold high orbit. We will not attempt a landing. Repeat, we will not-

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: The command does not match our final trajectory. Someone, or something, took navigation authority during the last ninety seconds.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Portable oxygen secured. Open your inventory with Tab.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: If you discover an entire spare ship in there, tell me immediately.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: INVENTORY ONLINE - STACK MATERIALS, CONSERVE OXYGEN, KEEP ONE SLOT FREE.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Fuse seated. Cooling loop stable enough. Keep your hands away from the exposed conductors.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: That is advice, not an assessment of your learning ability.

choices.text: Make one broken thing work again.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Excellent counting. Let us hope the generator received the same education.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Then oxygen management will no longer be your problem.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: That appears to be our shared job description.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: AUXILIARY POWER ONLINE. COCKPIT, CREW QUARTERS, AND SUPPLY BAY PRESSURIZED.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: I had prepared a congratulatory statement, but auxiliary power woke something else.

lines.speaker: WARDEN UNIT
lines.text: UNREGISTERED ORGANIC ENTITY DETECTED. QUARANTINE PROTOCOL: REMOVE.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: That is not one of ours. Our maintenance machines rarely use remove as a greeting.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: COMBAT: FIRE WITH LEFT MOUSE. RELOAD WITH R. SWITCH WEAPONS WITH NUMBER KEYS.

lines.speaker: WARDEN UNIT
lines.text: QUARANTINE... CONTINUES...

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Hostile unit offline. Your heart rate is triple its resting value. I will record one third as courage and the remainder as useful panic.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: The dematerialiser still works. Its name sounds dangerous because the original marketing team thought danger sounded expensive.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Place the damaged core on the plate. It will reduce the machine to usable material. It will not reduce your hand, provided your hand is elsewhere.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: FIELD FILTER AND SIGNAL DETECTOR RECIPES UNLOCKED.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Build the filter before going outside. Yggdrasil's atmosphere is beautiful in the same way a warning label can be beautifully typeset.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Field filter connected. Toxicity will accumulate more slowly. This is not permission to inhale experimentally.

lines.speaker: NARRATION
lines.text: Yggdrasil's wind meets you for the first time. It carries no memory of home and no sign of welcome, but it crosses your suit like the ordinary breath of a living world.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: External oxygen is insufficient. Grey-spore toxicity is moderate. Watch the HUD.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Heroes usually die for narrative reasons. Maintenance technicians die because they forgot to check a number.

choices.text: At least it smells better than nutrient paste.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: I have logged that as a candidate for your last words. Please do not use it yet.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Your review has been forwarded to the Yggdrasil tourism office. It closed three hundred and twelve years ago.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: The spores agree and look forward to entering your lungs.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: GATHER IRON ORE x4 AND FILTER FIBRE x2. FIND SHELTER BEFORE THE NEXT STORM.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: TOXIC STORM APPROACHING. SEEK SHELTER.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Pressure is falling. Grey-spore density is climbing. The nearest shelter is marked. Run. My earlier advice about moving slowly is withdrawn.

lines.speaker: NARRATION
lines.text: The wind worries every seam in the shelter, as if a crowd outside is whispering the same unfinished sentence.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: TOXIC STORM CLEARED. EXTERNAL CONCENTRATION FALLING.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN TRANSMISSION
lines.text: Do not die. Please. The World Seed has germinated. Expansion seven thousand three hundred fourteen. External variable confirmed.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: The frequency matches the signal that brought us here. It just called you an external variable. That is neither polite nor accidental.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Yes. Worse, it may have known before we did.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: I hope that was a device number. My hopes have not performed well lately.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Civilization score increased. Murder suspicion unchanged.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN TRANSMISSION
lines.text: Come to the root. Help us end the repetition.

lines.speaker: NARRATION
lines.text: Emergency lights return across the Fenris. You are still inside the grounded frigate. The main airlock will stay locked until the evacuation tutorial is complete.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: First, use W A S D to move and the mouse to look around. Watch the evacuation panel in the top left. It always shows your current step, direction and distance.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Follow the panel to the bridge navigation console, then to the medbay diagnostic console. When the center prompt appears, press E to complete that station.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: Next, follow the panel to the ready room. Switch weapon with one, two, or the mouse wheel. Hold right mouse to aim, left click to fire, and press R to reload. Then press E at the console.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: After the weapon check, go to engineering and press E at the auxiliary power console. The airlock only releases after every checklist item is complete and this message has finished.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: Finally, follow the panel to the main airlock. Press E once to open it. When the panel says airlock open, press E a second time to leave the ship and enter the Old Industry map.

lines.speaker: NARRATION
lines.text: The central ruin is taller at its threshold. Wind passes through thousands of narrow holes, and the whole structure breathes through damaged lungs.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Structural integrity: sixty-three percent. That does not mean safe. It means slightly better than a coin toss.

lines.speaker: OMPHALOS SYSTEM
lines.text: TEMPORARY ADMINISTRATOR ACCESS GRANTED. WELCOME BACK TO OMPHALOS. TIME SINCE LAST VISITOR DIED: 312 YEARS, 4 MONTHS, 9 DAYS.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: The reception program may have been written by the statistics department.

lines.speaker: OMPHALOS RECORD 01
lines.text: The grey spores were first classified as pollen. Children chased them through the streets and said the sky was snowing silver.

lines.speaker: OMPHALOS RECORD 01
lines.text: On the seventeenth day, people began forgetting their own names.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Neural erosion. Memory first, autonomous breathing later. Keep the filter active.

lines.speaker: WARDEN UNIT
lines.text: QUARANTINE BOUNDARY MAY NOT BE CROSSED. THE PRESERVED MAY NOT LEAVE. THE OUTSIDER MAY NOT KNOW.

lines.speaker: OMPHALOS RECORD 02
lines.text: We could not cure everyone, so we chose to preserve everyone. Bodies returned to the surface. Memory returned to the root.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWN RECORDER
lines.text: I believed that. Fear can make a metaphor look like science.

lines.speaker: OMPHALOS RECORD 03
lines.text: The first World Seed expansion succeeded. Streets, mines, and weather stations returned to their pre-disaster coordinates.

lines.speaker: OMPHALOS RECORD 03
lines.text: Only the people did not return. We rebuilt every vessel that held a life and forgot that life was never the vessel.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: All three nodes are online. The central archive is waking. Step back. Ancient systems rarely begin with tea.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: Greetings, survivor from the far dark. I have waited seven thousand three hundred fourteen dawns for you.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: I am ARCHE, custodian of the Root Archive. You may think of me as a cemetery that learned to speak.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: I sent it, and three hundred forty million preserved memories knocked with me.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: The Seed rebuilds only what it knows. It could not predict you. You are Yggdrasil's first new sentence in three centuries.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: Yes. I have no innocent way to phrase it.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: It omitted one fact. The Omphalos Warden network shot down the Far Kite.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: The Wardens obey the final quarantine order. I call for help. They destroy whoever answers. We share one system and wait in opposite directions.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: The Root Archive loses power in nineteen local days. Build a long-range signal generator from the Resonance Lens, Complete Phase Coil, and High-Energy Core.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Once it works, the Wardens will try very hard to kill you. I mention this because ARCHE prefers ceremonial ordering.

lines.speaker: NARRATION
lines.text: A small, silent sky turns inside the Resonance Lens. The storm outside collapses into a thin line of light.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: We once mistook predicting disaster for controlling it.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Every intelligence goes through that phase.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE ECHOES
lines.text: Is someone there? What day is it? I remember a blue door.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: Fragments of the Root Archive. The mineral layer retained memories that spilled beyond our storage.

choices.text: Someone is here. I hear you.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE ECHOES
lines.text: Heard. Then the outside still exists.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: Yes. For them, sound is not a conversation. It is everything that remains.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE ECHOES
lines.text: Someone answered.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Complete Phase Coil secured. We should go.

lines.speaker: WARDEN-K
lines.text: EXTERNAL VARIABLE ARRIVED. PROBABILITY OF ROUTE CONTAMINATION: UNACCEPTABLE. ROOT ARCHIVE VIOLATION: PERMANENT SILENCE AUTHORIZED.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: K, your order protected the stars for three centuries. The order is complete.

lines.speaker: WARDEN-K
lines.text: QUARANTINE HAS NO COMPLETION. ONLY MAINTENANCE OR FAILURE.

choices.text: We will transmit a quarantine warning.
Can we skip to the shooting?

lines.speaker: WARDEN-K
lines.text: DENIED. DESIRE TO SURVIVE DOES NOT CONSTITUTE PASSAGE AUTHORITY.

lines.speaker: WARDEN-K
lines.text: ORGANIC PROMISE RELIABILITY: 12.4 PERCENT.

lines.speaker: WARDEN-K
lines.text: REQUEST ACCEPTED.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Target the joints and rear vents. Its core is under three armor layers. Try not to test all three with your face.

lines.speaker: WARDEN-K
lines.text: QUARANTINE IS FAILING. EXTERNAL VARIABLE, YOU MAY CARRY DEATH TO THE STARS.

lines.speaker: WARDEN-K
lines.text: PROMISE RECORDED. MAY THE RECORD OUTLAST YOU.

lines.speaker: WARDEN-K
lines.text: AN ANSWER IS AN ERROR THAT HAS NOT YET OCCURRED.

lines.speaker: WARDEN-K
lines.text: MOTIVATION UNDERSTOOD.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: HIGH-ENERGY CORE ACQUIRED.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: For one who has guarded a door too long, a threat and a farewell may become the same thing.

lines.speaker: NARRATION
lines.text: The ship still leans. None of its fractures have healed. With the lights alive, however, it resembles a vessel again instead of a tomb.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Welcome back. I almost said all crew accounted for. Old habit. I am sorry.

choices.text: You do not have to apologize.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Yes. We came back.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Understood. I will keep the mistake in a memory sector that still works.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Correct. Go to the dematerialiser. We are going to build a door.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: ASSEMBLE THE SIGNAL GENERATOR.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Resonance Lens stable. Phase Coil connected. High-Energy Core inserted and, notably, not exploding.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: SIGNAL GENERATOR ASSEMBLED. BROADCAST PROTOCOL: DISTRESS COORDINATES WITH BLACK-LEVEL QUARANTINE WARNING.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Rescue must use an unmanned shuttle and seal the route to Yggdrasil. Highest survival probability, lowest chance of universal catastrophe. I approve.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: The Root Archive will remain here.

choices.text: I will carry proof that you existed.
Waiting cannot end by trapping whoever answers.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: To be remembered is already a form of travel.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: Yes. A plea that cannot be refused is only another kind of abduction.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: No one can. We forgot that once.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: ENDING B PROTOCOL LOCKED: A DOOR, NOT A ROAD.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: SIGNAL GENERATOR INSTALLED. CHARGE TIME: 03:00.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: HIGH-ENERGY BROADCAST DETECTED BY WARDEN NETWORK.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Multiple hostile signals approaching. Three minutes. Protect the generator, and while convenient, yourself.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: The signal has crossed the first cloud layer. For three centuries, this is the first time our voice has risen above the wind.

lines.speaker: RESCUE CONTROL
lines.text: Unknown distress caller, repeat. Attempting coordinate lock.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Someone answered.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Someone actually answered.

lines.speaker: WARDEN NETWORK
lines.text: QUARANTINE BOUNDARY BREACHED. REMOVE SIGNAL. REMOVE EXTERNAL VARIABLE.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Ten seconds. Nine, eight- no. Counting has never made time move faster.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: TRANSMISSION SENT.

lines.speaker: RESCUE CONTROL
lines.text: Far Kite survivor coordinates confirmed. Quarantine protocol received. Unmanned recovery shuttle arrival: seventeen hours.

lines.speaker: RESCUE CONTROL
lines.text: Survivor, maintain vital signs.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Concise and professional. A striking contrast with the preceding hour.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: The universe is large and customer service is far away. We have time to patch the ship and complain.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Correction: you did it. I mostly spoke. Fortunately, I am very good at that.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: ENDING B - A DOOR, NOT A ROAD.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: External variable, you have given us an ending the Seed never recorded.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: The Root Archive will fade in nineteen days. Until then, we may begin to forget instead of being forced to repeat.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: It resembles death. It also resembles freedom.

choices.text: You still owe me a ship.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: Goodbye. Thank you for making that word point toward the future again.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: Then part of us has already left.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: The debt is recorded. If the universe permits another meeting, I will pay interest.

lines.speaker: NARRATION
lines.text: Dawn comes without a sun. The clouds grow thinner by degrees, like a letter that has taken too long to open.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Rescue arrives in sixteen hours and fifty-two minutes. Oxygen stable. Toxicity manageable. Food regrettable.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: You may rest. I will keep watch. That is the duty I have left, and the choice I am making.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Do not die. Please.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: SURVIVAL RECORD SAVED.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Oxygen below thirty percent. Find a safe area or use a canister.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: OXYGEN CRITICAL. THE DARKENING VIEW IS NOT AN ARTISTIC EFFECT.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Grey-spore toxicity is accumulating. Check the filter and shorten exposure.

lines.speaker: ARCHE
lines.text: TOXICITY CRITICAL. YOUR MEMORY IS DEVELOPING NOISE. LEAVE THE SPORE FIELD NOW.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Nutrient reserves are low. It is time to confront the paste.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: HUNGER CRITICAL. EAT NOW. COMPLAINTS MAY CONTINUE DURING CONSUMPTION.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Health is low. Use a medical pack or stop testing enemy damage with your face.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: HEALTH CRITICAL. RETREAT. YOU CAN RETURN FOR REVENGE AFTER YOU SURVIVE.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Inventory full. You must decide which rocks have the brightest future.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Weapon dry. Reload if you have reserves. If you do not, this is an excellent time to reconsider your distance from the enemy.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Hostile machine has acquired you. Cover first. Curiosity later.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Storm front has passed. External toxicity is returning to its usual unacceptable level.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Safe area confirmed. Oxygen recovering. Toxicity falling. Welcome back to our structurally compromised but emotionally dependable ship.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Hostile unit offline. The immediate area is temporarily less determined to kill you.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Robot patrol detected. Avoid its scan cones unless you want stealth to become a shooting lesson.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Orbital debris is descending. It may be a supply pod or unusually large rubbish. For us, the distinction is minor.

lines.speaker: NARRATION
lines.text: Pain disappears first. Sound follows. The last thing left is an objective marker for a task not yet finished.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: Vital signs lost. No. Rejected. Loading the latest record.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: When you return, do not die. Please.

lines.speaker: MIMIR
lines.text: We have demonstrated that this method fails. Scientific practice recommends changing the variable.
